schema.description: `BOOKED -> CHECKED_IN -> COMPLETED`, `BOOKED/CHECKED_IN -> CANCELLED`, `BOOKED -> NO_SHOW`; the last three are terminal.
schema.title: AppointmentState

parameters.name: atRisk
parameters.description: `true` narrows to appointments flagged at risk.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC 3339 start of the overlap range (inclusive).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC 3339 end of the overlap range (exclusive).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500 (default 100); anything else is 400 `invalid-limit`. A query parameter the collection does not declare is 400 `unknown-query-parameter`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque page token, copied from the previous page's `nextCursor`; absent for the first page. A value that does not decode is 400 `invalid-cursor`. Repeat the filters on every page request.
